# pve_vm_disk_resize (Action)

Resize a VM volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_disk_resize" "example" {
  config {
  disk = "ide0"
  node = "pve1"
  size = "CHANGE_ME"
  vmid = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_disk_resize.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (String) The disk you want to resize. One of: `ide0`, `ide1`, `ide2`, `ide3`, `scsi0`, `scsi1`, `scsi2`, `scsi3`, `scsi4`, `scsi5`, `scsi6`, `scsi7`, `scsi8`, `scsi9`, `scsi10`, `scsi11`, `scsi12`, `scsi13`, `scsi14`, `scsi15`, `scsi16`, `scsi17`, `scsi18`, `scsi19`, `scsi20`, `scsi21`, `scsi22`, `scsi23`, `scsi24`, `scsi25`, `scsi26`, `scsi27`, `scsi28`, `scsi29`, `scsi30`, `virtio0`, `virtio1`, `virtio2`, `virtio3`, `virtio4`, `virtio5`, `virtio6`, `virtio7`, `virtio8`, `virtio9`, `virtio10`, `virtio11`, `virtio12`, `virtio13`, `virtio14`, `virtio15`, `sata0`, `sata1`, `sata2`, `sata3`, `sata4`, `sata5`, `efidisk0`, `tpmstate0`.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `size` (String) The new size. With the `+` sign the value is added to the actual size of the volume and without it, the value is taken as an absolute one. Shrinking disk size is not supported.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `digest` (String) Prevent changes if current configuration file has different SHA1 digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.
- `skiplock` (Boolean) Ignore locks - only root is allowed to use this option.
